text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On our way back from an outing, Tucker 
Brine and I stopped by a bookstore.

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
There are so many new releases that caught 
my eye! Practical books useful for 
trailblazing, manuals on training theory—
choice_data_list:
There was a book I wanted to check out 
too!
There was a book I wanted to look at, too!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
I see! Then we shall split up for a short 
while. Let us meet up at a good spot!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Knowing her wild yet sharp nature, she 
might just brazenly pile up expensive 
technical books and buy them all at once!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Thinking about that, I searched for the 
book I had been curious about... After a 
quick purchase, I looked around for her, 
and—

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
........Hm! This book... Just as I 
thought.

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
The title's been changed, but it's pretty 
much a revised edition. The content is 
practically identical to that book from 
ten years ago.

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
However, there are newly revised chapters 
as well...! Then again, it's only a few 
dozen pages. Is it cost-effective...? No, 
coming from this author, it's bound to be 
worthwhile!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Whaaat...! Every single book on my list is 
actually here?!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
What an incredible selection this shop 
has! But buying it all would blow my 
budget... No, wait!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Just pull it from the reserve funds! What 
else is a household budget for?! Tucker! 
Buy whichever books you desire to your 
heart's content!

text_block_list.name: Clerk
text_block_list.text: Do you have a point card with you?

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Ah, yes. I have one. I also have a coupon 
on the app, can I combine them?

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Yes..., yes... Oh, I can receive a fair 
bookmark? . Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It's different from what I imagined…… No, 
maybe I should say it's just as expected. 
Wild, but not uncouth—that distinct vibe……

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
—! Trainer!? You were here...!? Wh-What 
are you laughing at...?

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text: *AHEM*!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Kept ya waitin'! There were way too many 
great books, I totally lost track of time! 
Dwahahaahaha!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text: Hahaha...! Ha......

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
...No, I get what you're trying to say! 
But, how should I put it...! Uuuugh......

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I merely smiled naturally, but she seemed 
somewhat awkward about it. Her wild side 
isn't her only charm, after all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Striving to be her ideal self, she always 
worked hard and carried herself with 
dignity. Knowing how serious she truly 
is...
choice_data_list: (Better not bring it up on purpose.)

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer-san?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tucker Brine watched closely. Determined 
to clear the air somehow, I decided toâ
choice_data_list: How about we head somewhere relaxing next?

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text: A-Ah! Of course...!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text: This place is...
choice_data_list: Ah, it's about to start, hurry!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"You don't have to say anything if you 
don't want to." With that sentiment in 
mind, I silently gazed up at the celestial 
sphere throughout the screening.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Because she is herself, after all...)

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
—Wahaha! That was a blast! Just like a sky 
full of stars on a deserted island! And it 
made finding seasonal constellations so 
easy to understand!
choice_data_list: Let's go look for it next time!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, let's look for it! Next time, 
together! Feels like we'll get a real 
taste of majestic nature!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Nah... it's nothing! Today was an absolute 
blast! Dahahahahaââ!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text: A walk……? Ah, of course, I'd love to.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
We walked down to the beach. However, the 
awkward atmosphere between us remained 
unchanged.

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Ah, well, y'know...! Th-That's one heck of 
a big ocean...!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text: Huh, Trainer――!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I headed down to the beach and ran with 
all my might! I thought exercising might 
clear my head, but I tripped over a piece 
of driftwood—

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text: Are you alriiiight?!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Your hem is soaking wet! Whoa, another 
wave is coming...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (SPLAAAASH!)

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text: Ngh...!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text: Hahaha...! What the heck are you doing...!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Heh...... You're... a good person, you 
know that?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After that, she got her groove back. We 
ended up soaking wet, but all's well that 
ends well!
